prompt.project_info: Three-view photorealistic post-workout gym portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original athletic woman with dark-brown hair in a slightly messy high ponytail, wet sweaty strands framing the face, flushed fair skin and focused exhausted expression; wearing a pastel-pink fitted crop sports top with sweat patches and matching relaxed pink joggers.
prompt.composition_elements: Create three views: close-up cross-body shoulder stretch with gaze off-camera; medium front-facing shoulder stretch with mirror behind; profile beside the mirror with one hand on the glass and the other lifting the top hem slightly to inspect a naturally defined midsection. Public gym with wall-to-wall mirrors, blurred cable machines, dumbbells and warm hanging lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm overhead artificial gym lighting creates realistic specular highlights on sweat, soft bokeh and raw focused post-workout mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Mix of close-up, medium and profile shots, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin and fabric texture, accurate mirror reflections and natural anatomy.
